title: TurboMamba: Faster Inference, Faster Training, and Better Prediction with Lexical Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.20682v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce TurboMamba, a language-model architecture for faster inference, faster training, and better token prediction. A global Mamba-3 model runs once per completed token block. A small Transformer uses this global context and earlier tokens within the block to predict the next token. Three lightweight additions improve local predictions: direct access to the previous block's last token, a small correction to next-token scores, and a learned mixture with recent-token frequencies. We compare twelve small-scale implementations on public FineWeb-Edu, with comparable parameter counts and shared training-budget caps. The baselines include Transformer, Mamba-3, Jamba, and Zamba. The Jamba and Zamba versions use Mamba-3 in place of their original Mamba modules. TurboMamba achieves the lowest mean test prediction loss (negative log-likelihood, NLL) among all twelve models. translated_title: TurboMamba：借助词汇记忆实现更快的推理、更快的训练与更好的预测
translated_abstract: 我们提出了TurboMamba，这是一种能够实现更快推理、更快训练和更好词元预测的语言模型架构。一个全局Mamba-3模型在每个完成的词元块上运行一次，一个小型Transformer利用该全局上下文以及块内较早的词元来预测下一个词元。三种轻量级改进提升了局部预测效果：直接访问前一个块的最后一个词元、对下一词元分数的小幅修正，以及与近期词元频率的学习型混合。我们在公开的FineWeb-Edu数据集上比较了十二个小规模实现，这些模型具有相近的参数量和共享的训练预算上限。基线模型包括Transformer、Mamba-3、Jamba和Zamba，其中Jamba和Zamba版本使用Mamba-3替换了其原有的Mamba模块。TurboMamba在所有十二个模型中实现了最低的平均测试预测损失（负对数似然，NLL），其平均NLL比Mamba-3低9.4%，比其他模型也更低。
tldr: TurboMamba通过结合全局Mamba-3模型、小型Transformer和词汇记忆等轻量级机制，在实现更快推理与训练的同时，取得了比Transformer、Mamba-3、Jamba和Zamba等基线模型更低的预测损失。
en_tdlr: TurboMamba combines a global Mamba-3 model, a small Transformer, and lightweight lexical memory mechanisms to achieve faster inference and training while attaining lower prediction loss than baselines including Transformer, Mamba-3, Jamba, and Zamba.
